name: Desai Manali
review: One of my best decision to join Prenatal classes with her. Our sessions were online but her cues and instructions made it so simple and eased out exercise. When I started my chief complain was intense Pubic pain and lower backache but with the help of her guidance and correct ergonomics the pain went in few days and didn't came back. Also due to pregnancy there were lots of physical pain and discomforts but it all eased out with the help of her. Truly without her my pregnancy journey wouldn't be so smooth. Would highly recommend to all the moms- to be to make your pregnancy journey beautiful with the help of her. Thank youu Zalak mam for being part of my pregnancy journey now that I look back I can't imagine this journey without u ..!

name: Aashima Kadakia
review: Training with Zalak was such a wonderful experience. She introduced me to Pilates in the most positive, encouraging way, and thanks to her classes, I truly fell in love with the practice. What sets her apart is not just her expertise in Pilates, but also her deep understanding as a physiotherapist. I could genuinely feel my core getting stronger and my body becoming more aligned after I started training with her. She is attentive, knowledgeable, and creates a space where you feel comfortable yet motivated to push yourself. Highly recommend her to anyone looking to begin or deepen their Pilates journey.

name: Anjali Hardik Desai
review: My physiotherapy classes with Zalak ma'am were a real lifesaver for me. The hospital recommended them at just the right time, and they helped me so much during my pregnancy. They supported me physically, mentally, and improved my mood. I was always excited for each session, and Zalak ma'am felt like family. She took such good care of me, and her advice helped me throughout both pregnancy and postpartum. Zalak mam explains everything very patiently, which really helps clarify things. In the beginning, my body was quite stiff, and when I started exercising, I felt a lot of ease in my movements. In the initial months of my pregnancy, I also had back pain, but after taking these sessions, that back pain disappeared, and my delivery was completely normal. Now, I feel so much better in my body because of these classes. Zalak mam you are doing such a great job—you are changing lives, especially for moms like me. I really want this to reach as many people as possible. Thank you so much, Zalak ma'am, for all your support and care—what you do is truly amazing

name: Dipika Mishra
review: My very first Pilates session was with Zalak, and honestly, I had no clue what to expect. As a physiotherapist, she's been my secret weapon ever since , fixing my posture, wiping out my chronic backache, and helping me get leaner and stronger, all through her expert Pilates techniques. If you are looking for the absolute best Pilates instructor, Zalak is it. She's transformed my body and confidence without any gimmicks!

name: Poonam Soni
review: Dr. Zalak Shah is very knowledgeable, compassionate, and always took time to listen. I had a wonderful experience attending Dr. Zalak's prenatal classes. Nd huge thanks to you ma'am for being constant supportive guide during my pregnancy nd for guiding me through each excercise step by step. Ensuring proper technique and understanding... In my case I had C- section due to some complications in last period but I was up on the very second day due to excercises that I did during pregnancy which guided by you, my muscles were trained so good in Ante natal period. Highly recommend Dr. Zalak to all expecting mommy!!..

name: Khushbu Patel
review: I connected with Dr. Zalak Shah through Motherhood Hospital during my pregnancy, and I am so grateful for her support and guidance throughout this journey. Her expertise in prenatal physiotherapy helped me manage the physical changes and discomforts of pregnancy with ease. She provided practical exercises and posture corrections that made a real difference in my daily comfort and energy levels. What truly stood out was her continued support in the postpartum period. Her advice and customized recovery exercises were incredibly helpful in regaining strength and healing after delivery. She explained everything patiently, made sure I was comfortable with the pace, and genuinely cared about my well-being. I highly recommend her to any expecting or new mother looking for professional, compassionate physiotherapy care. Her guidance has been a key part of my smooth recovery and overall motherhood experience.

name: Sumeen Rattan
review: Connected with Dr. Zalak through Motherhood hospital Science City, she indeed is a very trained and empathetic professional. Attended physiotherapy sessions conducted by her till the last day of my term. I had severe RIB PAIN and SCIATICA PAIN during my 3rd trimester, thanks to her the pain eased out and I was able to recover well during post partam. She is very encouraging, gives personal attention and remembers every detail about her patients. As a result of constantly working out during pregnancy my baby is also healthy and has lean muscle. As they say if the mother works out during her pregnancy the baby is born with good birth weight and is very active. I am thankful to Dr. Zalak for motivating and guiding me throughout my pregnancy journey. Keep up the good work. Highly recommended.

name: Krupa Trivedi
review: A huge thanks to Dr. Zalak Shah, for being such a supportive guide during my pregnancy! Her prenatal exercises—like breathing techniques, and gentle stretches—were incredibly effective. Her positivity and constant motivation kept me going, even on tough days. Highly recommend her to any expecting mom!

name: Hir Patel
review: Over the last few months, Pilates has completely transformed my life. Not only has it strengthened my body, improving my posture and core stability, but it has also become a powerful tool for stress relief and mental clarity. I feel more connected to my body, moving with greater ease and confidence in everyday activities. The discipline and consistency of my practice have spilled over into other areas of my life, making me more mindful and present. What started as a workout has become a form of self-care, leaving me feeling stronger, more balanced, and truly rejuvenated, with all thanks to Dr. Zalak Shah for believing in me and making me believe in myself.

name: Priyanshi Desai
review: I had the pleasure of zalak shah's physio session during my pregnancy, and I can't recommend them enough! From the very first session, they made me feel at ease and provided excellent guidance to help me manage pregnancy-related aches and pains. The exercises and stretches they recommended were tailored to my specific needs, and I could immediately feel a difference. Not only did I feel physically better, but I also gained valuable insights into how to take care of my body as it changed. She was very knowledgeable, compassionate, and always took the time to listen. If you're pregnant and in need of physiotherapy, this is the person to see!

name: Trupti Sapariya
review: I had a wonderful experience attending Zalak prenatal classes. She is an exceptional instructor who patiently guides you through each exercise step by step, ensuring proper technique and understanding. Her expertise in breathing techniques was especially helpful during my labor phase—I truly believe I wouldn't have been able to deliver naturally without her guidance and support. Beyond being an amazing teacher and yoga-Pilates trainer, she is also a great mentor and friend. Her classes not only prepared me physically but also gave me confidence and mental strength throughout my pregnancy. I highly recommend her prenatal classes to every expecting mother—it's an experience that makes a real difference!

name: Jayshree Chaudhari
review: Thank you very much Dr. Zalak. We have benefited a lot from your guidance. Physically and mentally too. You made our pregnancy journey very easy.

name: Hetanshi Patel
review: Dr. Zalak provided me with immense support throughout my pregnancy. I was experiencing SPD pain but she guided me with the right exercises and consistently supported me

name: Yachna Sharma
review: Dr.Zalak is very professional and experienced women health physiotherapist. She guides very well in doing antenatal exercises and gives comprehensive guidance about labor pain. Highly recommended

name: Chaitali Zaveri
review: In my 9th month pregnancy all of a sudden I started having horrible pelvic pain, which restricted me in any kind of movements like walking, getting up, sitting down, etc. My pain was so severe that pain killers were also not working. My Gynec advised me to visit Dr Zalak. Dr Zalak is a good solution provider, she did some case study and showed me some exercises which would help in relieving my pain. For about 2-3 days I did all the exercises she showed me, and on the 3rd day I was able to walk properly without support which was not possible earlier. She is well knowledgeable and prescribes exercises depending on the situation. I am very happy with the solution she provided me. Slowly and gradually after following her prescription my pain got decreased by 70-80% and that also just within a week. I highly recommend Dr Zalak for any women physiotherapy related challenges.

name: Riddhi
review: I have received ante natal exercises treatment from Dr. Zalak during my pregnancy. She has provided me great support and guidance throughout my pregnancy for mobility exercises which kept me going for 9 months. I was feeling active throughout as she pushes you to do better in each successive sessions. She makes it look easy to be pregnant and do the normal delivery. In my case, i had a surgery as there were some complications of baby weight but the best part is even after surgery i was up on the very second day due to exercises that I did in pregnancy. My muscles are trained so good in ante natal.

name: Prachi Desai
review: Thank you so much Dr Zalak you've been a great help during my labour journey. I wouldn't have thought to manage and survive this pain without your help. You are such an amazing doctor I would recommend you as a doctor to expecting mothers. Thanks again doctor

name: Dhwani Dave
review: Dr. Zalak has been an amazing help for my pregnancy. I had a normal delivery and I believe that her guidance played a great role in it. She's thoroughly professional, extremely helpful and considerate, and most of all, she knows what she is doing. She not only helped me with my prenatal exercises, but also kept me informed and aware, and guided me throughout the entire pregnancy. 100/10!

name: Ekta Ruhalyan
review: Zalak mam is one of the few people who I really want to thank for making my pregnancy period much smoother. Under her guidance i enjoyed doing antenatal exercises. Birth prep session by her helped and motivated me till the delivery time .Thank you for all the support and care. Keep serving the society especially mothers with your great work.

name: Krupa Patel
review: Had a great experience with motherhood and Midas touch hospital. Special thanks to Dr. Zalak Shah for all the physiotherapy session. All her session, tips and guidance help me a lot. Thank you very much Dr. Zalak for all your support.

name: Darpan Mistry
review: I am incredibly grateful to Dr. Zalak Shah for the exceptional physiotherapy care provided to my wife during her maternity period. Dr. Shah's expertise and compassionate approach made a significant difference in my wife's comfort and recovery. She tailored a personalized treatment plan that addressed my wife's specific needs, ensuring she felt supported and informed every step of the way. The exercises and hands-on techniques greatly improved her mobility and reduced pain, making her pregnancy and postpartum experience much smoother. I highly recommend Dr. Zalak Shah for her professionalism, empathy, and outstanding care.

name: CA Juhi Agrawal
review: She has created wonders during my pregnancy period. Whatever pains I was undergoing, all pains vanished by her suggested exercises. Thanks a ton mam for such relieving treatment in the most important stage of my life. You are just amazing ! Keep up the good work.

name: SMITA SOLOMAN
review: Dr. Zalak Shah has been my yoga teacher and I just wanted to thank her for helping me to make that positive change in my life during pregnancy. Just wanted to thank her for the yoga class. It was really nice to see how she genuinely enjoy teaching yoga poses and the pleasure she get from sharing her knowledge with others. Her passion for yoga is very infectious and I would highly recommend every one to join her antenatal yoga classes.

name: Ruchi Shah
review: Zalak is a wonderful person. She is smart and well versed with the exercises. Her personal attention on the exercises during my pregnancy had helped me keep my health in check.
